programmes.d: While flying to a cabin in Vermont, Ann, Donald and their pilot land in a snow storm after they run out of gas.
Ann and Donald leave the crash site and find a cabin to stay in. Her father sends out a search party.
Ann gets a card from a stockbroker and invests in the list of items on the back, even though it is his shopping list.
Ann's father hires a musical group to increase business at his restaurant. He doesn't know that the group performs nude.
As class treasurer, Ann loses $360 that was saved for their reunion. Ann looks for the thieves.
Felix tries to reform after his finicky attitude towards food ruins an otherwise pleasant dinner with his ex-wife.
Felix's new romantic interest is not the librarian he thinks she is.
Oscar's young niece, Martha, arrives at the apartment in an advanced state of pregnancy and tells her uncle she has run away from home because her parents object to her decision.
Oscar becomes a somnambulist and vents his frustrations against Felix.
Felix selects a grave site and entrusts Oscar with the money for a down payment.

Mike thinks Greg wants to be an architect after reading Greg's school essay, but Greg doesn't want to hurt Mike's feelings and tell him the truth. Meanwhile, the other Brady kids also begin thinking about their future careers.

The kids give Alice the cold shoulder after they think she has broken their trust, so Alice decides to leave her job as housekeeper. However, the kids soon regret the decision after the new housekeeper teaches them a lesson.
Marcia thinks that a girl who is suddenly interested in Greg is actually using him so that Greg will vote for her as head cheerleader--over Marcia.

Peter tries out for the role of George Washington in a school play, but gets the role of Benedict Arnold instead. But he then wants to quit the play altogether when his classmates start branding him as a "traitor."
Marcia has a crush on her new dentist, which only intensifies when she mistakes an opportunity to babysit for him as a date with him to the ballet.

Bobby doesn't want to be safety monitor for his class because his classmates now hate him. However, he soon abuses his power and begins reporting on his family when they break house rules. Meanwhile, the family salvages an old sailboat.
Ann Marie is a meter-maid who tickets the mayor's car.

Peter gets a job at the bike shop, but he is fired after three days. He doesn't want to tell his parents the bad news, because he told the family he might be getting a promotion to salesman the day he got fired.

Cindy loses her mom's earrings after playing with them, and "detective" Peter Brady tries to solve the mystery. But when Carol wants the earrings for a costume ball and they're still not found, the entire family tries to crack the case.
The Brady girls try to play matchmaker between Carol's free-spirited grandmother and stick-in-the-mud Grandpa Brady.

Cindy studies hard and passes a test to appear on a TV quiz show, but an overconfident Bobby does not. But after she passes, he ego goes out of control. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol make plans for a dinner party.
Ann has to go to court to help a producer win a lawsuit involving a shish-kebab skewer.
Ann sees her neighbor Ruthie kissing another man.
After Donald injures his back in her apartment, Ann brings his interviewer to Don.
Don wants to take Ann to the theater on her birthday. However, Ann promised to babysit a sick child.
Donald finally asks Ann Marie to marry him and takes his buddies' advice to buy the ring second-hand.
Oscar discovers he's in poor physical condition and reluctantly goes along with Felix's suggestion that he build himself up.

After Felix induces Oscar to appear on the popular talk show Steinberg is guest-hosting, his roommate gives a riotous account of Felix's prissiness. Felix is incensed, and when Steinberg invites him to make a rebuttal, he leaps at the opportunity.
Hoping to get closer to his son, Felix becomes coach of the boy's football team.
Blanche tells Oscar she is remarrying and invites him and Felix to the wedding.
